text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's packed with worshippers! We'll 
have to be prepared to wait in line for 
quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Having run relentlessly all the way to the 
end of the year, waiting leisurely in line 
for the New Year isn't so bad either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and the three of us 
from the trainer team went for Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still... everyone lining up here has come 
with their New Year's resolutions in mind, 
haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As Meek's Trainer, I hope we can keep 
moving forward together this year.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, not just that. I also want the 
road I ran together with Meek— our 
hoofprints—to be remembered and passed 
on."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...I agree. That's just how irreplaceable 
it was."
choice_data_list:
Let's do our best this year so we can pass 
on the tradition!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! All right, I have to pray 
properly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the arrival of the new year, the 
Trainers all made fresh resolutions 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um... Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry for calling you out so 
suddenly. There was something I wanted to 
tell you all.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"So three whole years have passed since I 
first met you all in this place, huh."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, a lot of things happened during 
that time.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I got a good, close look through 
your Umamusume trainees.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
The joy of growing, the pain of facing 
hardship, and the strength to overcome 
that hardship—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"As Trainers, you stayed close by your 
Umamusume and lived up to their feelings."

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"...That is why this time, I wish to see 
it firsthand. Everything you two have 
achieved together as one!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...!? By directly, you mean...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...So the Umamusume we train are to face 
you, the Three Goddesses, in a match.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will send invitations to the Grand 
Masters to your four Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
No, I suppose this time it's more like a 
"challenge letter"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an intimidating presence, entirely 
different from that of the Three Goddesses 
who normally supported them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the path we've walked with <chrname> is what has 
stirred up this much passion in the Three 
Goddesses—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You've still got that same fiery 
look in your eyes from when we first met.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
I won't hold back at all. Let us race each 
other with everything we have...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, facing the Three Goddesses 
alongside <chrname>, our entry into the Grand 
Masters to reach the pinnacle of umamusume 
was decided!
